[IDAT.12.3] **String-interning convention.** A single
per-engine string table interns schema / slot / rule
names and `String`-typed slot values ([IRET.1.4]).
Every string entering working memory is funneled
through the intern function at the boundary.
Pointer-equality comparison and one canonical pointer per
distinct string. A structural name lives as long as the
engine; a slot value lives as long as the facts that hold it
([IDAT.4.7]).
